events.factual_description: Wolf Trap presents Thee Sacred Souls on The Constellation Tour with LA LOM and The Womack Sisters at the Filene Center in Vienna, Virginia on Thursday, September 17, 2026 at 7:00 PM; gates open at 5:30 PM. Wolf Trap describes Thee Sacred Souls through its Chicano-influenced soul and classic R&B vocabulary, LA LOM through its mix of 1960s-inspired ballads and cumbia, and The Womack Sisters as carrying a family line connected to Sam Cooke, Cecil and Linda Womack, and Bobby Womack. Thee Sacred Souls' management independently lists the September 17 Vienna date and the same tour also reaches Baltimore on September 22.

en.why_it_matters: The bill works because the three acts connect different branches of the same groove language without feeling like a retro package. Thee Sacred Souls draw on Chicano soul and classic R&B, LA LOM turns cumbia and 1960s Los Angeles textures into instrumental music, and The Womack Sisters bring a living family line that runs through Sam Cooke and the Womacks while releasing their own debut this year. The combination gives the night a real musical through-line rather than three unrelated support slots.
en.trip_verdict: Actively make room for the Wolf Trap date if the evening is open. It is a strong local bill for soul, cumbia and groove, but the same tour reaches Baltimore five days later, so there is useful flexibility rather than a reason to rebuild larger plans around this one stop.

es.why_it_matters: El cartel funciona porque los tres proyectos conectan ramas distintas de un mismo lenguaje de groove sin sentirse como un paquete retro. Thee Sacred Souls parte del soul chicano y el R&B clásico; LA LOM convierte la cumbia y las texturas angelinas de los sesenta en música instrumental; y The Womack Sisters cargan una línea familiar viva que pasa por Sam Cooke y los Womack mientras publican este año su propio debut. La combinación tiene un hilo musical real, no tres actos pegados sin relación.
es.trip_verdict: Sí le haría espacio activamente a la fecha de Wolf Trap si la noche está libre. Es un cartel local fuerte para soul, cumbia y groove, pero la misma gira pasa por Baltimore cinco días después, así que hay margen para escoger sin tener que rehacer planes mayores alrededor de una sola parada.
